modelDescription: Stevens' 320 Field and Security Pump-Action Shotguns are fast-handling with synthetic stocks, making them perfect dual-purpose guns. Field-proven rotary-bolt with dual-slide-bar action for smooth-cycling reliability and fast follow-up shots. Carbon-steel barrel for heavy-duty durability. Tube magazine has a five-round capacity.
